# The gate has been reading a ticket that no longer exists

Record 1 stored `ticket_file` as `docs/tickets/SEEN-096-add-codegraph-and-repowise-and-assign-each.md`.
The three-way split on 24 September renamed that file to
`docs/tickets/SEEN-096-add-codegraph-and-route-the-graph-command.md`. `cli.state_for` reads the ticket
from the recorded path and falls back to the snapshot in record 1 when the path is missing, silently.

So every judgement on this ticket since the split has been made against the pre-split ticket, which
asked for codegraph, repowise and a stage assignment for each context tool, while the record being
judged describes codegraph alone. A record that looks incomplete against a ticket three times its size
is exactly what the model reported: 0.67, 0.68, 0.62, 0.66, 0.67, 0.46.

That does not overturn SEEN-100. Its measurement sent the same payload under both sets of criteria, so
the delta it recorded stands. What it means is that SEEN-096's absolute numbers were never about
SEEN-096 as it is now, and the honest decision at record 6 was scored against a ticket that had asked
for two tools this record had already given away.

The fallback is the defect. A ticket id is stable and a filename is not, so the harness should find the
ticket by its id and only use the snapshot when the ticket is genuinely gone, saying so rather than
pretending it read the file. This ticket's own split caused the rename, so the fix is carried here and
the acceptance criteria are amended to say so.
